title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support permission sync missed in incremental crawl
description: Earlier, permissions were synced only in the periodic full crawl which generally ha a default frequency of 1 day for most of the connectors. Now, we have support for doing permission syncs more frequently in an incremental way.
